name: How long does it take to install an egress window?
description: Installation typically takes 2-4 days, varying by foundation material, excavation needs, and weather conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an egress window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for an egress window can vary, but generally, a single installation can take 2-4 days. This estimate depends on factors such as the existing foundation material (concrete, block, etc.), the need for extensive excavation, weather conditions, and the complexity of the drainage system. For properties in areas like Oakland or Hayward, differing soil types can sometimes extend the excavation phase. We prioritize efficient and thorough work, ensuring all steps, including permitting and final inspections, are completed correctly.
